svg.title: What this local sandbox controls and what remains trusted
svg.desc: The design blocks direct egress, filters HTTP(S) destinations, keeps the Ollama key out of the agent process, and records proxy activity. It trusts the host and runtime, does not decrypt TLS, and does not enforce filesystem policy.
svg.text: Read the boundary before using the sandbox
✓ Direct internet egress from the workload
✓ Ollama key exposure to the agent process
STILL TRUSTED OR OUT OF SCOPE
• Windows host, WSLc runtime, images, sidecars
• TLS contents and data sent to allowed hosts
Local, single-user proof of concept · review the repo's security scope before use
